Whole-body health begins with a smile

Great dental care starts with trust and a genuine connection. As a family-owned husband-and-wife practice, we provide personalized, prevention-focused care that supports your whole-body wellness. We proudly serve patients in Montrose, West University, Rice Village, Boulevard Oaks, Southampton, River Oaks, and Greenway/Upper Kirby.

Our office sits in Montrose, minutes from West University, Rice Village, Boulevard Oaks, Southampton, River Oaks, and Greenway/Upper Kirby. Many of the families we care for live or work just south of Highway 59 and make the short trip up Kirby or Shepherd for dentistry that looks at the whole person, not just one tooth. You can read more about each neighborhood on our areas we serve page.

From our warm, welcoming environment to the familiar faces you’ll see at every visit, we’re here to help you and your family feel comfortable, cared for, and confident, every step of the way.

modules.html:
Dr. Nour Amin

Co-Owner & General Dentist at My Dear Dentist

For Dr. Nour Amin, dentistry has always been more than a profession — it’s a lifelong calling. Known for her gentle touch, thoughtful care, and deep personal connection with every patient, she brings empathy and excellence to each visit. Alongside her husband, Dr. Shinta, she has built a family-owned practice rooted in whole-body wellness, personalized treatment, and a belief in addressing the root cause of oral conditions. For Dr. Amin, healing the mouth is the gateway to true overall health and wellness.

modules.html:
Dr. Mustafa Shinta

Co-Owner & General Dentist at My Dear Dentist

A lifelong learner with a passion for improving smiles. Dr. Mustafa Shinta brings a unique blend of science, skill, and heart to every patient visit. With a calming presence and a clear, thoughtful approach, he’s passionate about helping even the most anxious patients feel safe and understood. His whole-body perspective on dentistry emphasizes comfort, innovation, and lasting results, always tailored to each patient’s needs.
